room.hall.title: Hall
room.hall.description: A long hall with a worn [floor](floor). A door leads north to the garden.
room.garden.title: Garden
room.garden.description: A walled garden you have not seen before: gravel paths between box hedges, a stone bench under a pear tree, and a door south to the hall.
room.garden.familiar: The garden, as you know it well.
narration.walk: You walk the length of the hall and back.
narration.walk_b: You pace the hall, counting the boards.
narration.walk_c: You stroll the hall slowly, listening to the boards creak.
